## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is the alternative *kē wén* outline of [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Zōngmì's *[Zhù fǎ jiè guānmén](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0101)* (T1884), composed by [宗豫](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E8%B1%AB) Zōngyù — distinct from Zōngmì's own outline (preserved as [X1007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0103)). The existence of two parallel *kē wén* outlines of the same parent commentary attests the work's central pedagogical importance and the scholastic activity around it in the late-Tang Cǎotángsì circle.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (830 – 900) reflects the period of late-Tang activity at the Cǎotángsì 草堂寺 on Mt. Guīfēng 圭峰山, which Zōngyù is conventionally associated with as a contemporary or successor of Zōngmì. The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1008).
